# Politicz

> Local civic engagement guide and state-by-state ballot initiative, referendum, and direct-democracy reference.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://politicz.org/): Main Politicz civic hub.
- [Thesis](https://politicz.org/thesis.html): Overview of the Politicz thesis.
- [Law](https://politicz.org/law.html): Ballot access and direct-democracy law reference.
- [States](https://politicz.org/state/): State-by-state guides across all 50 states and DC.
